Refunds do not exist. Customer service does not want to help. If you have to refund an order, it’ll never happen. Order cancellation on the merchant or Fantuan side will take too long and by that time, you’ll be ineligible for a refund. I finalized an order by accident and immediately went to “request to cancel it” and I was not refunded. After explaining to customer service for two whole hours that the cancellation request was made immediately after ordering, they kept repeating how the merchant somehow already made the meal. I called the merchant right after the request of cancellation to tell them I do not want the order and they told me to dispute it through Fantuan and that they won’t make the order. It is a tennis game and you’re the ball having to go between. For some reason the merchant hit “ready to pickup” and then the Fantuan customer service kept saying they couldn’t cancel for that reason and refund me even though I informed both parties promptly that the order was a mistake. I just threw money into their pockets for no service.

我的外卖软件亲身经历. 我以前用熊猫外卖，发现有些时候送餐可以按时到，很多时候一直要等很久都不来，而且联系不到客服非常frustrating，还发现他们滥收费，本来10块钱的外卖一下子加上很多额外捆绑费用飙升到17、18块钱，真的很夸张！之前也试过Uber Eats，送餐准时率不错，但是作为中国胃的选项不够多，而且送餐费+小费真的很高，不划算。后来用饭团外卖，实话实说，95%的餐都会按时送到，甚至还有很多时候提前送到。有个别暴风雨，暴风雪的时候，没送到，我就一键联系客服，客服超快速度给我道歉退款，二话不说。我用饭团会员两年了，整体体验感非常好，沟通顺畅，餐厅优惠也很多，非常推荐！
